title: Earth Embeddings in Environmental Remote Sensing
abstract: arXiv:2611.13612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Earth observations from satellite platforms have profoundly transformed research and applications across numerous domains. However, uneven observation coverage and frequent data gaps continue to limit their ability to capture Earth's surface dynamics. Moreover, processing multi-modal Earth observations requires substantial computational resources and sophisticated data harmonization frameworks, which may not be readily accessible to many remote sensing practitioners. Earth embeddings have emerged as promising solutions to these challenges. As general-purpose representations converted from multi-source Earth observations, Earth embeddings can support a wide range of downstream tasks with no requirement of task-specific feature design and preprocessing. translated_title: 环境遥感中的地球嵌入
translated_abstract: 来自卫星平台的地球观测已深刻改变了众多领域的研究与应用。然而，不均衡的观测覆盖和频繁的数据缺口仍然限制了其捕捉地球表面动态的能力。此外，处理多模态地球观测需要大量的计算资源和复杂的数据协调框架，而这可能并非所有遥感从业者都能轻易获取。地球嵌入已成为应对这些挑战的有前景的解决方案。作为从多源地球观测转换而来的通用表示，地球嵌入无需任务特定的特征设计和预处理，即可支持广泛的下游任务。在本研究中，我们首先介绍了地球嵌入的理论基础，然后回顾了几种代表性的地球嵌入产品，接着考察了地球嵌入的应用。
tldr: 本文系统阐述了地球嵌入的理论基础并回顾了代表性产品，展示其作为多源地球观测的通用表示，能够在无需任务特定设计与预处理的情况下广泛支持环境遥感下游任务。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically introduces the theoretical foundations and representative products of Earth embeddings, demonstrating how they serve as general-purpose representations of multi-source Earth observations that support a wide range of downstream remote sensing tasks without task-specific feature design and preprocessing.
